dialogue.line: Woah! You're so good at this honey!!
You two are naturals at this! Maybe y'all should look into being vocalists...
We're good heh... but thank you, means a lot
Anyways we better get going, Wev'e got a reservation soon.
ow wait just a minute, we'd like to get an interview before you lads run off.
We?
Yep, sorry, I was parking the van.
Uhm, who are you two...?
Hun, it's the lady who runs the news...
Oh! I see!
We've been hearing you lot sing for a little bit. So are y'all up for it?
Yeah!
Sure we've got time to kill before we hit the road!
And how bout you two?
Nah, we're about to go out to dinner.
We wouldn't want to reschedule our reservation... heh
Makes sense to me.
Alright mates, we've got a tight deadline at the station.
So be there at 8PM sharp.
Sounds good!
Alright well we better get going now! It was really fun singing with y'all!!
You guys have fun!
Bye bye!
Seeya!
